component.name: Saifori
component.summary: Track your spending and plan your budget
Controla tus gastos y planifica tu presupuesto

description.p: Track income, expenses, budgets and spending trends with native GTK4 and Libadwaita.
Keep a local record of income and expenses, set category budgets, and compare spending across months. Transfers are tracked separately from income and spending.

Use the optional AI assistant with your own provider account and API key. Requests send your submitted text, recent chat context and financial aggregates to the selected provider. Provider usage may incur charges. Core ledger features work offline without an account.
Records and exported backups are not encrypted. Privacy Mode hides information on screen only.
